name: fleet-client
description: The `fleet` command, which runs outside dsh: `fleet run <agent-dir>` runs an agent directory in the tau format in its own session and container, through the Unix socket fleet-core's fleet-control plugin serves in the fleet host, and `fleet setup image` builds the session image fleet-box uses

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
